bio.text: Kim Schrier represents Washington's 8th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives and was first elected on November 6, 2018.
Before Congress she worked as a pediatrician in Issaquah.

She graduated from U.C. Berkeley with a degree in astrophysics, attended medical school at U.C. Davis, completed her residency at Lucile Packard Children's Hospital at Stanford University, and lives in Sammamish.
